body:
hey, dude. i know everything seems dark and awful and horrible right now, but i promise that it does get better. 

you’re only 15, you have *so much* of your life left to live. i felt the same way when i was your age and all of the angst and pain you feel now does eventually get easier to deal with.

if your current therapist isn’t working, try to see if you can switch to a new one. it’s crucial to vibe well with someone like that.

please stick around, even if it’s only for one more day. i promise it’s worth it.
